request: Change the shape of the profile of link arms to the shape of long hole to increase its stifness. Then change the diameter of the holes by 1mm and adjust the shape accordingly.

actions.operation: Edit the link arms profile sketch/outline to a long-hole (slot) shape

parameters.definition_method: slot defined by end-pivot centers; parallel sides tangent to end arcs
design_intent_constraints: Maintain symmetry about the line connecting the two end pivot hole centers for each link plate
Keep end-pivot hole centers concentric with the slot end arcs (same centers)
Keep a constant ligament (wall thickness) from each end hole edge to the outer profile

actions.relational_constraint: Resulting profile shape should match a long-hole (slot) shape
actions.unresolved_reference: Which specific link arm feature(s)/body(ies) and which specific profile sketch controls their shape; what dimensions/aspect ratio/orientation define the desired long-hole shape
steps: Edit each link plate body (S03, S04, S05, S06) using its large planar face as the sketch plane (e.g., S03 face 0022 or 0023; S04 face 0035 or 0036; S05 face 0048 or 0049; S06 face 0061 or 0062) to redefine the outer perimeter/profile driving the plate outline.

In the sketch, project/convert the two end pivot hole circles (end holes) as references (S03 holes at cylinders 0025 and 0026; S04 cylinders 0038 and 0039; S05 cylinders 0051 and 0052; S06 cylinders 0064 and 0065). Extract or constrain to their centers.
Create a construction centerline between the two end pivot hole centers; constrain it as the slot centerline axis for symmetry (outer profile symmetric about this axis).

Use a 'Center-to-center slot' (a.k.a. 'straight slot') tool to create the external outline: set the slot end centers coincident with the two end pivot hole centers; the slot end arcs become concentric with the end pivot hole centers; set slot width as a parameter W_profile.
Constrain the slot sides to be parallel to the centerline and tangent to the end arcs; fully define W_profile and the center-to-center length L_profile (driven by end hole center distance).

If the existing model includes local bulges/boss-like curvature near the central hole, remove those from the external outline and keep the outline as a pure slot to match the 'long hole' intent; keep the central hole within the slot boundary with sufficient ligament.

Regenerate the plate solid by using the modified sketch as the base profile for an 'Extrude (mid-plane)' or 'Extrude (symmetric)' operation to the original plate thickness (keep existing thickness per plate layer), ensuring the side perimeter faces update consistently (these correspond to the perimeter faces listed above).
Propagate the same profile parameters and constraints to all four link plates (S03–S06) to maintain assembly symmetry between +Z and -Z sides and between the two crossing members.

apply_to: link plate end pivot holes (2 per plate)
link plate central pivot hole (1 per plate)
parameters.note_on_blocks: If corner pins are increased, verify upper/lower block fixed pivot hole and slot width provide clearance; update them if they are intended to match the same pin diameter.

actions.relational_constraint: Hole diameter to be changed by 1mm (direction not explicitly stated)
actions.unresolved_reference: Which hole features (all holes vs specific subset); whether 'by 1mm' means increase or decrease; whether holes are circular holes only or includes slot end radii
steps: Increase diameters of the three through-holes in each link plate by +1.0 mm: select each cylindrical hole face and apply 'Offset/Move Face' radially by +0.5 mm (radius increase) to achieve +1.0 mm diameter (S03: 0024/0025/0026; S04: 0037/0038/0039; S05: 0050/0051/0052; S06: 0063/0064/0065). Alternatively, edit the sketch/hole feature if available and set D_new = D_old + 1.0 mm.

To maintain functional fit with the updated link plate holes, increase the mating pin/spacer outer diameters by +1.0 mm: apply cylinder face offset +0.5 mm radius on corner pins (S07 shanks 0074, 0077, 0080, 0083) and central spacers (S08 cylinders 0086, 0089). Keep pin axes unchanged to preserve coaxial relationships.

Check block interfaces for clearance/fit with the updated corner pin diameter: (a) fixed pivot holes in blocks (S01 face 0010; S02 face 0021) should be increased by +1.0 mm diameter if these are bearing holes; (b) sliding slots in blocks should increase slot width by +1.0 mm if they guide the same corner pins (update slot end radii by +0.5 mm on cylindrical ends S01:0006/0008, S02:0017/0019; and move each slot side wall outward by 0.5 mm on planar slot walls S01:0007/0009, S02:0018/0020).

Regenerate and verify assembly constraints implied by the model relationships: pins (S07) remain coaxial with link plate end holes and contained in blocks (S01/S02), and central spacers (S08) remain coaxial with link central holes (S03–S06).

actions.operation: Adjust the (long-hole/profile) shape to accommodate updated hole diameter

parameters.adjustment_rule: keep constant minimum ligament from hole edge to outer profile after hole diameter increase
parameters.recommended_constraint: outer slot end radius = end-hole radius + ligament
parameters.recommended_ligament_handling: increase W_profile by +1mm if profile is controlled by tangency to end-hole-based arcs; otherwise offset outer profile outward by +0.5mm around end regions

actions.target: shape of link arms / long-hole shape (from Action 1)
actions.relational_constraint: Update the surrounding/related profile so it remains consistent with the new hole diameter
actions.unresolved_reference: What dependency must be preserved (e.g., slot end radius equals hole radius, constant wall thickness around holes, concentricity/alignment between holes and slot ends)
steps: Re-open the link plate outer-profile sketch created/edited in Action 1 on each plate plane (S03–S06). Ensure the slot outline is constrained to the end pivot hole centers and not to the previous hole diameters directly, so that only controlled dimensions need updates.

After hole diameter increase (+1.0 mm), enforce constant ligament: set/retain a parameter 'ligament' (distance from end-hole circle to outer profile). Update the outer slot width W_profile and/or outer end arc radius such that: Outer_End_Radius = (End_Hole_Diameter/2) + ligament. Because End_Hole_Diameter increased by 1.0 mm, Outer_End_Radius should increase by +0.5 mm to preserve ligament.

If the slot sides are defined by tangency to the end arcs, increasing the end arc radius will naturally move the parallel sides outward; otherwise, explicitly increase W_profile by +1.0 mm (0.5 mm per side) to preserve the same wall thickness around the end holes.

Validate that the central hole (S03:0024, S04:0037, S05:0050, S06:0063) still has adequate edge margin to the new outer slot boundary; if required, increase W_profile further or add local symmetric relief/fillet transitions so the minimum ligament around the central hole meets the intended stiffness/safety margin without creating sharp stress risers.

Rebuild/regenerate all four link plates and confirm no interference with the blocks and pins in the multi-view context (front/back show end-pivot alignment into block slots; left/right show Z-stack clearance between plates).

intention: Increase stiffness of the link arms
Maintain correct kinematic fit between link holes and their mating pins/spacers after diameter change
Preserve symmetry and coaxial joint behavior across the duplicated +Z/-Z link plate stack
